exposure: Mortality group (infants with EOS who died before hospital discharge)
Survival group (infants with EOS who survived to hospital discharge)
outcome: Death in infants with early onset sepsis (EOS)
finding: Low birth weight, pulmonary hypertension, septic shock, heart failure, elevated serum lactic acid, and elevated AST were identified as risk factors for death in neonates with EOS.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant factor in the univariate analysis of risk factors for death in infants with EOS.
